text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian pushed herself desperately 
forward. Yet, she was painfully aware that 
her body was drawing closer to its end as 
an athlete.

However, no matter what pain it entailed, 
she had no choice but to keep running in 
order to fulfill herself.

Having realized Narita Brian's true 
intentions, Mayano Top Gun resolved to act 
before her "end" arrived—

Just as Narita Brian had once made her 
heart race with excitement, she vowed to 
make Brian feel that very same "thrill" 
through her own running.
